subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: What permanent contract should `feishu_drive info` use for files that are not discoverable from the first root listing page?
rationale: The remaining fix likely needs a user-visible folder-aware tool contract or a different metadata lookup path, and the maintainer comment explicitly warns against automatic root draining for Feishu bot credentials.

options.title: Add scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose or accept an explicit folder-scoped lookup for `info`, paginate only within that concrete folder, and require focused regression plus Feishu or SDK-boundary proof.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Document `info` as root-only and require agents to use `list` continuation to browse shared folders before selecting files.

options.title: Use direct metadata lookup
options.body: If Lark provides a reliable bot-compatible metadata endpoint by token and type, switch `info` away from folder enumeration instead of adding folder pagination.

recommendation.title: Add scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose or accept an explicit folder-scoped lookup for `info`, paginate only within that concrete folder, and require focused regression plus Feishu or SDK-boundary proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the list-half fix and stated the remaining folder-aware contract constraint on this issue.
